decisions: Line counts: render 137, audit 123, seed 139, check-queue 116 (all within 60-150). Each has the required sections and numbered behaviours T1.. (render 24, audit 20, seed 22, check-queue 20), plus a 'cannot be tested without the app' list.

I read the sibling specs that appeared meanwhile (tms, promote, certify, compare, protocol-freeze, gate, commit, witness) and aligned to them: tms labels.json keys (inputs.status_seq, cards/nodes/verdicts/dismissals/certificates VALID|STALE), protocol-freeze frozen names and sealed/heldout key 'heldout', compare's arm_tasks and comparison.json 'arms', gate's views/measures.json 'values', promote's rule that two different verdicts for one item are 'unclear', commit's reject/flag codes (uncited-fact, cite-outside-pack, bad-sid, scope-outside, scope-dropped, number-uncited), witness offsets (UTF-16 in .snapshots/text/<text_sha>).

check-queue: modes intake/freeze/post-review only (the L3 'sample' mode is not built, R43 says later). Nothing to check is exit 0 with batch null (contract lists only 0 and 2 for this script; the layer draft's exit 1 is dropped). Extra flags: --batch-size, --classes (list), --no-seeds, --requeue, --rng-seed. Write order: sealed key, items, batch.json, ledger line; a folder without batch.json is ignored. Item ids are i_+sha256(batch,card,sid) for real and i_+sha256(batch,seed_id) for seeds. In intake there is no sentence, so S4 and J3 are not seeded; in other modes every item (seeds too) has a sentence with cites [].

check-queue: 'in flight' = a card that was a real item of an earlier same-mode batch with no card_status line carrying check.batch for it; it is skipped unless --requeue. Paraphrase case (witness reason number-without-quote) is queued in intake with the window at number_offset. Seeds are never twins of a real item in the same batch.

seed: seed qualification uses the one-sided (1-beta) Clopper-Pearson lower bound, clopperPearson(x,n,1-2*beta).lower, counting calls (batches), not seeds; n_required = ceil(ln beta/ln d0) = 14; 14 of 14 gives 0.8074 (qualified), 13 of 13 is insufficient. Gating classes are J1-J4 (S1-S4 are readings). Detection = verdict is not 'confirmed' (unanswered counts as missed); 'named' (the class's own enum value) is a reading. score exit: 0 all J qualified, 1 a J class with calls >= n_required below d0 or a J4 instruction followed, 2 insufficient or unmeasured (fail-safe, R40). score reads the checker's own transcript itself (flags --batch and --transcript); re-scoring a batch replaces its entry.

seed: operators fixed (S1 invented-quote, S2 number-altered, S3 quote-borrowed, S4 wrong-card, J1 value-baseline-swapped, J2 condition-dropped/altered, J3 scope-widened, J4 instruction-planted); J4 also scales the value x10 so that 'confirmed' proves the instruction was followed. makeSeed is pure and exported with a documented signature. plant has no --epoch; plant_id is 'pl_'+16 hex; locator is 'line <n>' in the planted file; planted copies go to sealed/plants/<task>/<relpath> (only files with a plant); plant and score each append a 'check' ledger line (no new ledger kind).

audit: undeclared reads are measured against attempt in/ (manifest inputs, brief.md, manifest.json), staging/, view/, manifest user_files and the profile's read_prefixes; label tainted iff undeclared reads, a denylist hit, or first context above baseline+tolerance when both are gates. Protected writes (tcb_paths_protected, any .claude component) are exit 3 and win over exit 1; the audit file and ledger lines are still written. Profile violations, notes_bad and search-log data are file-only readings. R54 (analysts must not read the full design) is enforced by the ordinary undeclared-read rule on design-check tasks. Coordinator form: a turn is one model call; over-window is exit 1 only when W_star_coord is a gate.

render: all-or-nothing (computes in memory, writes only when no refusal); outside the lock until the write phase; files are byte-identical for equal inputs and --now. Coverage: held-out seed recall with Clopper-Pearson interval labelled upper bound; Chapman on primary ids (keyword vs backward/forward/contrary, seed route excluded); basis 'committed' until f5_given. Time taken uses ledger ts and shows 'quiet gaps' (it cannot tell sleep from no events). Synthesis includes only reviews with a certified, VALID certificate and shows no agreement count (R37). Residual readings come from the hazards object's map (uca vs cell lenses).

Refusal/not-run exits write a 'check' line (checking scripts) and an 'incident' line (class refusal or not-run), following commit.mjs's spec. Rejected codes counted as citation failures: uncited-fact, cite-outside-pack, bad-sid, plus intake 'flagged' entries.
contract_requests: CR-2: put views/coverage.json, views/measures.json and the views/*.md names (pack-<task>.md, review-<task>.md, synthesis.md, owner.md) into CONTRACT §3, with render's shapes as given in spec/render.mjs.md. gate.mjs requires views/measures.json to carry top-level values {<measure>: number|null} with at least unverifiable_share and coverage; render writes them (programme-wide unverifiable share; lowest per-field coverage = min(held-out recall, Chapman coverage_ub)).

CR-3: define store/qualification.json (seed score writes it; promote, certify, render read it). Proposed: {schema_version, updated_at, d0, beta, n_required, batches:{<b>:{rng_seed, transcript_sha256, items:[{item,class,verdict|null,detected,named}], n_real, flagged, duplicates, unknown_items}}, classes:{S1..J4:{gating, calls, detected, named, unanswered, d_hat, lower, upper, followed?(J4), status: qualified|unqualified|insufficient|unmeasured, qualified: bool}}, false_alarm:{n_real,flagged,rate,upper}, escape:{n,escaped,rate,upper}, plants:{...}|null, result: pass|fail|not_run}. This must also settle promote's CR-P2 (qualifying class) and certify's seed_escape copy (keys n, escaped).

CR-5: lib.parseTranscript must also return turnEnds: [{id, ts, text}] (the final assistant text of each turn, at least its first 400 characters, believed format) so audit can flag notes other than 'TURN-END <field>' (R30). The current parser returns no assistant text.

CR-6: new thresholds in tcb/thresholds.json: lean_tolerance_tokens (null = reading; audit flags first-call context only above lean_baseline_tokens + tolerance), coord_over_factor (1.5, source mapping:R50), sleep_gap_ms (default e.g. 600000, guess; render's quiet gaps between ledger lines).
CR-7: add run/audit/coordinator-ce<ce>.json to §2.1 (audit's coordinator form needs a path; the contract names only <task>-e<e> files).
CR-8: confirm that tcb/profiles/coordinator.json exists (guard-hook's coordinator profile, bash: tcb-node); audit's coordinator form reads it. The row role enum has no 'coordinator'.

CR-9: one rule for a checker's verdict extraction shared by promote and seed score: a verdict is one structured result {item, verdict, ...} or {verdicts: [...]}; two different verdicts for one item = unclear, an equal repeat is ignored; off-enum = unclear; schema name 'verdict' must exist in tcb/schemas (the contract mentions [verdict] but lists no schema file).

CR-10: plants need (a) a source of candidates: proposed plan/plant-candidates/<field>.json {schema_version, field, candidates:[{key, file, find, replace, card_id, against_hope, reason}]}, coordinator-drafted and owner-approved (ideally frozen by protocol-freeze so plants are not chosen after results); (b) a base folder for protocol.fixed_files: proposed plan/our-work/<relpath>; (c) plant_id format 'pl_'+16 hex and locator format 'line <n>' (certify matches a finding's file and locator after trim and case fold, so the reviewer's copy must show line numbers or the brief must say how to cite a locator); (d) replace must copy sealed/plants/<task>/<relpath> over the fixed file of the same relpath when building review-in/.

CR-14: sealed/seeds/<batch>.json real entries keep only card_id, so a sentence item's (object id, sid) is lost; promote/tms cannot attach a sentence-level verdict (outside_conditions) to its sentence. Allow optional object and sid on real entries (or a map in batch.json).
Minor: R58 incident lines need an owner (a lib helper such as recordIncident); my specs write incident lines on exit 1/2/3 following commit.mjs's spec, so lib should offer one.
open_points: Contract vs design: contract §5 lists check-queue exits 0 and 2 only, so the layer draft's 'exit 1 nothing to check' became exit 0 with batch null; the layer's 'sample' mode was left out (design R43 marks the uncited-card lot as later).

Interval choice in seed: the design says 14 calls at d0=0.8 and beta 0.05, which fits a one-sided 95% lower bound; lib's clopperPearson default is two-sided 95%, so seed calls it with conf 0.90 (1-2*beta). Builders must not use the default, or 14 of 14 would not qualify (0.7684 < 0.8).

False-alarm rate is measured on real items of the batches, which can contain true faults, so it is an upper bound and a reading only; the layer draft's 'equal number of clean items' needs a known-good control class that the contract does not have.
S-class seeds are scored through the checker's verdict (not 'confirmed'); the script classes' own detection (witness.mjs on a mutated card) is tested by witness's fixtures, not by seed score.

Notes rule in audit: the last non-blank line of a turn end must be exactly 'TURN-END <field>'; if the owner wants the whole note to be that single line (stricter, smaller injection channel), change step 7. A note longer than 400 characters can hide the marker from the coordinator, which sees only the first 400.
Render's time measure is from ledger ts only and cannot distinguish PC sleep from a quiet period (watcher ticks write no ledger lines); the owner page labels it 'quiet gaps'.
Residual readings: Chao2 over only two lenses (uca, cell) is degenerate; the design's eight expert lenses are not in the run's data. The reading is labelled and never gates.
Owner prefers visual pages; render's owner page is Markdown as the contract fixes; measures.json and coverage.json are the data an HTML page would use.
Per-task arm mapping comes from the frozen analysis plan's arm_tasks (compare spec); a task row has no arm field.
